title: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma and Perineural Invasion

steps.tx: Adenoid cystic carcinoma grows slowly yet relentlessly from minor and major salivary glands, cribriform Swiss cheese patterns around pseudocysts, invading nerves far beyond palpable tumour. Its patience deceives: **adenoid cystic carcinoma, slow but relentless**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Slow growth, distant perineural reach, late lung metastases: adenoid cystic carcinoma plays a decades long game.

steps.tx: Perineural invasion lets adenoid cystic carcinoma travel named nerves to skull base, producing pain, paraesthesia, and palsies while imaging underestimates microscopic extent along the pathway. That highway is **perineural invasion in adenoid cystic carcinoma**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Pain along a nerve's map in salivary cancer means perineural travel; image the nerve to skull base.

steps.tx: Histological pattern grades adenoid cystic carcinoma: tubular best, cribriform intermediate, solid worst, solid share above thirty percent worsening prognosis enough to alter adjuvant decisions. Pattern grading is **adenoid cystic carcinoma tubular, cribriform, solid grading**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Count the solid pattern; above thirty percent, adenoid cystic carcinoma's prognosis darkens decisively.

steps.tx: Late pulmonary metastases arrive five, ten, even twenty years after controlled primaries, often indolently, so adenoid cystic follow up never truly discharges and chest imaging persists. That horizon defines **late metastasis surveillance in adenoid cystic carcinoma**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Discharge is a fiction in adenoid cystic carcinoma; lung metastases keep appointments decades later.

steps.tx: MYB oncogene rearrangement, classically MYB-NFIB fusion, drives most adenoid cystic carcinomas and increasingly confirms diagnosis in small biopsies while trials chase its downstream pathways. The molecular signature is **MYB-NFIB fusion in adenoid cystic carcinoma**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: MYB rearrangement confirms adenoid cystic carcinoma molecularly when scant biopsies leave pathologists uncertain.

steps.tx: Palatal adenoid cystic carcinoma ulcerates late over bone it silently erodes toward nasal cavity and skull base, so palatal swellings with pain earn cross sectional imaging before biopsy conclusions. That erosion pattern is **palatal adenoid cystic carcinoma imaging duty**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: A painful palatal swelling needs imaging depths before reassurance; adenoid cystic erodes bone silently.

steps.tx: Radiotherapy, especially neutron and particle therapy historically and modern photon or proton techniques, sterilises perineural microscopic disease beyond surgical margins in adenoid cystic carcinoma. Field design follows nerves: **perineural radiotherapy fields in adenoid cystic carcinoma**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Radiation fields in adenoid cystic carcinoma are drawn along nerves, not merely around tumour beds.

steps.tx: Prognostic counselling in adenoid cystic carcinoma must quote decades, not five years, because survival curves keep falling while many patients live long with metastases under observation. Honest horizons define **long term counselling in adenoid cystic carcinoma**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Quote ten and twenty year horizons in adenoid cystic carcinoma; five year survival flatters it.
